visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with shoulder-length brown hair and glasses wears a pink turtleneck sweater, speaking directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor office or clinic setting. A circular overlay displays a close-up of a nose with prominent blackhead pores, highlighting the medical topic of discussion. (2) The scene cuts to a clean graphic of a silver metal acne extractor tool against a white background, with red arrows pointing specifically to the small wire loop at its tip, emphasizing the precise instrument used for skin treatment. (3) A 3D anatomical animation depicts a hair follicle beneath the skin surface, where yellow sebum starts to accumulate and build up within the pore, eventually reaching the surface where it turns dark due to oxidation, forming a blackhead. (4) The animation continues showing the metal loop tool being pressed firmly against the skin's surface, causing the plug of oxidized sebum to be pushed out of the follicle cleanly, illustrating the mechanism of extraction through even pressure application. (5) The woman reappears in her studio, gesturing with her hands and holding a small black microphone to explain the safety of the method, while a graphic of a sparkle appears near her hand to emphasize the skin protection benefit mentioned. (6) The final phase shows a static outro screen with a white and gray textured background, displaying the clinic's logo DRX and extensive contact information including a Line ID, phone number, and two physical addresses in Mandarin.
